subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome-Immune System Interactions
subtopics.description: Research on how gut microbial communities shape host immune responses, including IgA production, T cell tolerance, immune checkpoint modulation, and mucosal immunity. Covers commensal bacteria-driven immune regulation and dysbiosis-associated immune dysfunction.

subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cells in Mucosal and Gut Immunity
subtopics.description: Studies on innate lymphoid cells (ILC3s, ILC2s) and their roles in regulating intestinal inflammation, microbiota sensing, immune tolerance, and mucosal barrier function. Includes ILC3 survival signaling, CTLA-4 expression, and dietary fiber-driven ILC2 responses.

subtopics.label: Fungal Microbiome (Mycobiome) in Health and Disease
subtopics.description: Research on the role of fungal communities in the gut and other body sites, including fungal-immune interactions, IgA/IgG regulation of fungi, mycobiome dysbiosis in IBD and COVID-19, and fungal involvement in cancer. Covers Candida, Kazachstania, and other fungal taxa.

subtopics.label: Microbiome-Bile Acid and Metabolite Interactions
subtopics.description: Studies examining how gut microbiota regulate bile acid metabolism, amino acid processing, and other metabolic pathways that influence host physiology, immunity, and disease. Includes bile acid signaling, TMA/TMAO production, and microbiota-derived metabolites in cancer and inflammation.

subtopics.label: Fecal Microbiota Transplantation and Therapeutic Microbiome Manipulation
subtopics.description: Research on fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) and other therapeutic interventions targeting the microbiome, including FMT for ulcerative colitis, pouchitis, and IBD-associated conditions. Covers donor strain engraftment, synbiotics, probiotics, and microbiome-guided therapies.

subtopics.label: Microbiome in Cancer and Immunotherapy Response
subtopics.description: Studies on how gut and tumor-associated microbiomes influence cancer progression and response to immunotherapy, including immune checkpoint inhibitors. Covers colorectal cancer, pancreatic cancer, gastrointestinal cancers, and antibiotic-mediated disruption of immunotherapy efficacy.

subtopics.label: Statistical and Computational Methods for Microbiome Analysis
subtopics.description: Development and benchmarking of statistical, machine learning, and bioinformatic tools for microbiome data analysis, including differential abundance testing, clustering, batch effect correction, and multi-omics integration. Covers methods such as MaAsLin2, ZINQ, ConQuR, and phylogenetic deep learning.

subtopics.label: Antibiotic Resistance Genes and Hospital/Environmental Microbiomes
subtopics.description: Research on the distribution and transfer of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) in hospital environments, urban settings, indoor dust, and wastewater. Includes metagenomic surveillance of opportunistic pathogens and AMR in clinical and environmental contexts.

subtopics.label: Microbiome in Transplantation and Immunocompromised Patients
subtopics.description: Studies on gut microbiome dynamics in hematopoietic cell and kidney transplant recipients, including colonization with pathogens, post-transplant diarrhea, antibiotic perturbation, and microbiome-mediated protection against infections. Covers clinical outcomes linked to microbiome composition.

subtopics.label: Microbiome in Inflammatory Bowel Disease and Intestinal Inflammation
subtopics.description: Research on gut microbiome alterations in IBD (Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis) and related intestinal inflammatory conditions, including dysbiosis, adherent-invasive E. coli, bile acid changes post-resection, and microbiome-guided treatment strategies.

subtopics.label: Urogenital and Reproductive Tract Microbiomes
subtopics.description: Studies on microbial communities in the cervicovaginal tract, urinary tract, and placenta, including associations with schistosome infection, HPV persistence, UTI risk, and pregnancy outcomes. Covers microbiome composition and host-pathogen interactions in reproductive and urinary contexts.

subtopics.label: Microbiome and Host Biology During Spaceflight
subtopics.description: Research characterizing microbiome composition, immune responses, and multi-omics profiles of astronauts during and after spaceflight missions. Includes longitudinal studies of microbial shifts, skin and gut microbiome changes, and the Space Omics and Medical Atlas (SOMA).

subtopics.label: Diet, Nutrition, and Microbiome Interactions
subtopics.description: Studies on how dietary components—including fiber, fermentable carbohydrates, and specific nutrients—shape gut microbiome composition and downstream host metabolic and immune outcomes. Covers inulin, FODMAPs, synbiotics, and dietary restriction effects on microbial communities.

subtopics.label: Parasitic Infections and Microbiome Alterations
subtopics.description: Research on how helminth and parasitic infections (particularly Schistosoma species) alter host microbiome composition, mucosal immunity, and systemic immune phenotypes. Includes cervicovaginal microbiome changes and immune dysregulation associated with schistosomiasis.

subtopics.label: Gut Microbiome and Cerebrovascular/Neurological Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining the relationship between gut microbial communities, intestinal dysbiosis, and cerebrovascular events such as ischemic stroke, including protective bacterial signatures and gut-brain axis mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Respiratory and Upper Airway Microbiomes
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing microbial communities of the respiratory tract and upper airways, including the middle meatus, tonsils, adenoids, and oropharynx, and their roles in conditions such as chronic rhinosinusitis and aspiration pneumonia.

subtopics.label: Microbiome Sample Collection, Genetic Tools, and Methodological Advances
subtopics.description: Development and validation of practical tools for microbiome research, including novel stool collection and preservation kits, and genetic manipulation techniques for non-model gut microorganisms to enable mechanistic studies.

subtopics.label: Intestinal Barrier Function, Neonatal Gut, and Mucosal Healing
subtopics.description: Research on mechanisms maintaining or restoring intestinal barrier integrity, including pharmacological interventions for alcohol-related gut permeability, epigenetic regulation in necrotizing enterocolitis, and immune-mediated mucosal healing via hepcidin-iron sequestration.

subtopics.label: Engineered Bacteria and Synthetic Biology for Therapeutic Applications
subtopics.description: Studies employing genetically engineered or modified bacteria as therapeutic agents, including engineered probiotics designed to reprogram the tumor microenvironment and boost cancer immunotherapy efficacy.
